edit.description: A new field-less `Predicate::EngineMatches` variant beside `Fresh`/`LocusDeclared` (:549), its wire label `engine-matches` in both directions (:713 parse, :826 render), and its arm in the four classification chains (:864, :913, :966, :1017) — model the whole shape on `LocusDeclared`, which names no field either.

The variant's arms in the eight exhaustive matches that already list `Fresh | LocusDeclared` (:350, :410, :461, :641, :836, :1563, :2165, :3677) — selection, admissibility, field-lessness, root-only binding — and `root_clause` (:754) is the lookup the gate resolves it through.

Wire the judge beside the `locus-declared` (:717) and `fresh` (:760) root clauses: compare the committed lock's recorded engine against `crate::VERSION` and report at the clause's declared severity. Offline and lock-only — a lock recording no engine, and a run with no committed lock at all, report nothing.
The variant's arm in the predicate projection (:139), where `Fresh`/`LocusDeclared` already sit — a root predicate contributes no field schema.
The `engineMatches` constructor beside `fresh` (:262) and `locusDeclared` (:281), field-less, with the doc comment stating what it judges.

`rootDefaultContract` (:134) gains a fourth clause at `advisory` with `guidance` and NO `cite` — two of its three siblings carry none for the same reason, and a URL for temper's own stamp would be invented. The doc comment above it (:120) says 'Three clauses' and enumerates the three; it moves with the addition.
Regenerated data, never hand-edited: the root clause family gains the new row. Regenerate by the memberless emit its own header documents.

The in-module census `the_embedded_lock_parses_into_kind_facts_and_floor_clauses_only` asserts `root_labels` is exactly the three (:119-124); extend the expected list, and the two prose spots that call it 'the trio' (the comment :90-94, the assertion message :121-124) — never widen the `None` arm, whose whole job is to catch an unowned row.

The shipped example's committed lock carries the root default's clause rows (:330 reachable, :337 fresh, :343 locus-declared); the fourth lands here too, and `tests/it/emit.rs::emit_program_runs_the_shipped_example_harness` (:2432) byte-compares the file against what the example's own program emits. Regenerate, never hand-edit: `ln -s $PWD/sdk examples/base-harness/.temper/node_modules/@dtmd/temper` (gitignored), then `cargo run -- emit --into examples/base-harness/.temper`.

The frozen lane's expected root clause list (:191-193) and its lift-back predicate vector (:216-220) gain the row, and the cite assertion's prose (:200-206) — which names `fresh` and `locus-declared` as having nothing external — gains the new clause; pin that `reachable` stays the only cited root row.

The root contract's clause census (:347-352) gains the fourth entry and the `clauses[0].source` assertion's prose (:365-370) names it beside `fresh`/`locus-declared`, plus a case that a lock recording a different engine yields the advisory finding naming both versions and one recording this engine yields none.
The oracle's exhaustive predicate match (:194) gains the variant.
The emitted lock's root clause rows in the snapshot gain the new row.
The `rootDefaultContract` census (:233-239) gains the fourth predicate, its prose (:230-232 'all three', :245-248) moves, and the constructor's row round-trip gets a case beside `fresh`'s (:254).

TWO positional clause-row censuses enumerate the root default, not one: :248-261 (the full-harness emit) and :348-366 (the defaulted-root case, which also equates length against `rootDefaultContract`). Both gain a fourth block indexing `rootDefaultContract[3]`.

summary: A root default clause, advisory, reports when the committed lock records an engine version other than the one running the gate.

tests.asserts: a lock recording a different engine version reports the advisory finding naming both versions; a matching lock, a lock recording none, and a run with no lock report nothing
the embedded built-in lock's root clause family matches the SDK-derived one, the new clause included, and `reachable` is still the only cited root row
the shipped example harness re-emits byte-identically — the regenerated examples/base-harness/.temper/lock.toml carries the fourth root row
the shipped root default contract binds the new predicate at advisory with guidance and no cite

acceptance: cargo test and pnpm --dir sdk test green, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, and both regenerated locks — src/builtin_lock.toml and examples/base-harness/.temper/lock.toml — passing their byte-compares.
notes: Decision 0069, second consequence. Advisory: no adopter turns red on an upgrade, the posture the root's three shipped clauses hold. Spelling decided: `Predicate::EngineMatches` / `engine-matches` / `engineMatches()` / `root.engine-matches`. Guidance and NO cite — the verdict compares temper's own lock stamp against its own `VERSION`, nothing external. A widened root default moves label strings and emitted data too, so the census is `rg 'root\.locus-declared'`. scoped at 794074b6
